title: Slow English Podcast #348: 20 Easy Facts About Cape Verde

sentences.text: Today, we will learn about a beautiful island country.
The country is Cape Bird.
Some people also call it Cabo Verde.
I will speak slowly and use easy English.
Fact one, Cape Bird is an island country.
Cape Bird is in the Atlantic Ocean.
It is off the west coast of Africa.
The country is made up of 10 main islands and several smaller islands.
Each island has its own beauty and character.
Many visitors enjoy traveling from one island to another.
Fact two, the capital city is Praia.
Praia is the capital and the largest city.
It is on Santiago Island.
Many people live and work there.
The city has schools, markets, museums and restaurants.
Praia is the political and cultural center of the country.
Fact three, Cape Bird has beautiful beaches.
The country is famous for its beaches.
The sand is soft and the water is clear.
Many people enjoy swimming in the Atlantic Ocean.
Visitors also like walking along the beach at sunset.
The warm weather makes the beaches popular all year.
Fact four, Cape Bird has warm weather.
The climate is warm and sunny.
There are many sunny days every year.
Rain does not fall very often.
The pleasant weather makes outdoor activities easy.
People enjoy the sunshine in every season.
Fact five, the official language is Portuguese.
Portuguese is the official language.
Many people also speak Cape Verdean Creole.
Creole is the language people use every day.
Children learn Portuguese at school.
Visitors can also speak English in many tourist areas.
Fact six, music is very important.
Cape Verde is famous for its music.
One famous style is called morna.
Morna songs are calm and emotional.
People also enjoy Funana and Coladera music.
Music is heard at festivals, family parties and celebrations.
Fact seven, Cape Verde is known for its friendly people.
People welcome visitors with warm smiles.
Hospitality is an important tradition.
Families enjoy spending time together.
Neighbors often help each other.
Visitors usually feel comfortable and relaxed.
Fact eight, fishing is an important job.
The Atlantic Ocean provides many kinds of fish.
Many people work as fishermen.
Fresh seafood is common in local restaurants.
Fishing has been important for many generations.
The sea is a big part of everyday life.
Fact nine, Cape Verdean food is delicious.
One famous dish is called Kachupa.
Kachupa is made with corn, beans, vegetables and meat or fish.
It is the national dish of Cape Verde.
Families often cook it for special meals.
Fresh tropical fruits are also very popular.
Fact ten, there are mountains and volcanoes.
Not every island is flat.
Some islands have high mountains.
The island of Fogo has an active volcano.
The volcano is one of the country's most famous natural attractions.
Many visitors enjoy hiking there.
Fact 11, the ocean is perfect for water sports.
People enjoy swimming, diving, surfing and sailing.
The clear water is home to many fish.
Some visitors go snorkeling to see colorful sea life.
The ocean offers many exciting activities.
Fact 12, Cape Verde has many beautiful birds.
Different birds live on the islands.
Some birds fly across the Atlantic Ocean.
Nature lovers enjoy watching them.
The islands are peaceful places for wildlife.
Many protected areas help keep nature safe.
Fact 13, tourism is growing every year.
Many visitors come from Europe and other parts of the world.
They enjoy the beaches, sunshine and local culture.
Hotels and restaurants welcome tourists.
Tourism is important for the country's economy.
Fact 14, Cape Verde has colorful festivals.
People celebrate with music, dancing and traditional clothes.
Carnival is one of the biggest celebrations.
The streets become full of music and happy people.
Families and friends celebrate together.
Festivals are full of energy and joy.
Fact 15, the islands have beautiful sunsets.
Every evening the sky changes color.
The sun slowly goes down over the Atlantic Ocean.
Orange, pink and purple colors fill the sky.
Many people watch the sunset from the beach.
It is a peaceful moment.
Fact 16, Cape Verde has unique wildlife.
Sea turtles come to some beaches to lay their eggs.
Whales and dolphins can sometimes be seen in the ocean.
Many visitors take boat trips to watch these amazing animals.
Nature is one of the country's greatest treasures.
Fact 17, football is the most popular sport.
Children enjoy playing football after school.
Families watch football matches together.
The national team has many loyal fans.
Sports bring people together.
Football is part of everyday life.
Fact 18, life is peaceful on many islands.
Many towns are small and quiet.
People know their neighbors.
Life moves at a slower pace.
Visitors often enjoy the relaxed atmosphere.
It is a good place to rest and enjoy nature.
Fact 19, every island is different.
Some islands have sandy beaches.
Some have green mountains.
Others have volcanic landscapes.
Each island offers something special.
Many travelers visit more than one island during their trip.
Fact 20, Cape Verde is a wonderful country to discover.
It has beautiful beaches, warm weather, friendly people, delicious food, and amazing music.
The islands are full of natural beauty and rich culture.
Visitors can relax, explore, and learn something new every day.
Cape Verde is one of the most beautiful island countries in the Atlantic Ocean.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I hope you learned something new today.
Keep listening, keep practicing, and keep enjoying English.
My name is Emily.
See you in the next episode.
